member.name: T:EnterpriseTaskManagement.API.Middleware.GlobalExceptionHandler
member.summary:
Single place where exceptions become HTTP responses (.NET , wired through UseExceptionHandler). Every response is RFC 7807 JSON with type, title, status and detail.
Mapping: NotFoundException -> 404 ForbiddenAccessException (ownership rule) -> 403 ConflictException (duplicate email/code) -> 409 FluentValidation.ValidationException -> 400 (+ per-field errors) Application ValidationException -> 400 (+ per-field errors) DomainException (broken business rule) -> 400 ArgumentException -> 400 anything else -> 500 with a generic detail
Only messages authored by our own Domain/Application layers are echoed. Unhandled exceptions never expose their message, stack trace, connection string, credentials or token values — those are logged server-side only.
